risks.risk: Subordinate tooling silently mutates canonical identity.
risks.control: canonical_mutation=false; authority_transfer=false; Louksna hash pinned; fail closed
exact CUSTOSZ72 census + Family9 mapping + bind/extend-before-create

risks.risk: Massive corpus/model/translation workload overloads user host.
Mutable workflow/action dependency changes validation behavior.
risks.control: SHA-pin third-party actions and hash candidate inputs

risks.risk: Producer is effectively sole G23 evaluator.
risks.control: fresh read-only G23 + separate G24 + external second evaluator required

risks.risk: Long-lived provider secrets leak through repo/artifacts/logs.
risks.control: no secrets in candidate; least privilege; explicit provider adapters; OIDC when available

risks.risk: Massive corpus is processed without permitted rights.
risks.control: data-rights gate before remote corpus streaming

risks.risk: Stale market data is presented as live.
risks.control: source identity + event time + observed time + freshness/staleness state

risks.risk: Parallel translation silently loses/reorders semantic units.
risks.control: stable segment identity, source hashes, XLIFF-compatible mapping, global QA

risks.risk: Workflow green is misreported as G23/G24 certification.
risks.control: distinct semantic records; explicit NOT_PERFORMED/HOLD; same-digest chain

deny_if: RISK-005 remains OPEN for a claimed G23 PASS
external lane is claimed operational without material evidence
